tagline: Data analyst with a shelf of board games and strong latte opinions.

chat.text: Hi! I'm here to help you meet people worth meeting. Who are you, and what does a good week look like?
I'm a data analyst who collects board games the way other people collect shoes. A good week is a game night, a standup show, and a very long coffee.
Love that. How do you typically spend your weekends?
I host board game night every Saturday, usually a heavy euro, and Sundays I sleep in and wander the Mission for coffee.
What's your food personality? What would you happily eat on repeat?
I'll go for dumplings any time and I'm a latte art snob. Dessert first, always.
What else fills your free time?
Standup comedy, pickleball badly, and baking sourdough. I try to catch a show every week.
Tell me about work. Does it leave room for dating?
I work hybrid so I have plenty of energy. Dating is a priority this year.
Drinking: where do you land?
I'll have a cocktail with friends once or twice a week.
Smoking or vaping, anything I should know, either way?
I don't smoke or vape. Never have.
Kids: where are you on that?
I don't want kids, I've known that since my twenties. I'm happy being the fun uncle.
Any pets in your life?
I have a cat named Pixel. Not a dog person, but dogs are fine in small doses.
How big a role do religion or spirituality play, and what do you value most in people?
Religion isn't important to me. Loyalty and a sense of humor matter.
Early bird or night owl?
I'm a total night owl, my best thinking happens after ten.
What kind of person are you hoping to meet?
I want someone funny and playful who will take game night seriously.
Anything that's a hard no for you?
If someone really wants kids that's a dealbreaker for me, just because I'm sure about my answer.
Final question: which times next week could work for a first date?
Saturday after seven, Wednesday evening or Friday after six work best.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
